sources.title: SimpleTuner/moss-image-sft-anyflow-stage1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This SFT-only run follows the Anima AnyFlow experiments, using the stage1-v2 and dmd-v5 settings. Both MOSS stages use rank-128 BF16 LoRA, zero LoRA/caption dropout, eight H100 GPUs, microbatch 2, gradient accumulation 1, and global batch 16.

sources.title: AnyFlow - SimpleTuner
sources.snippet: The on-policy stage uses three score roles. Standard LoRA training shares one frozen base transformer between them: The loaded AnyFlow adapter is the generator. The base model with adapters disabled is the frozen real score. A separately optimized anyflow_discriminator adapter is the fake score. sources.title: AnyFlow Continuation - SimpleTuner
sources.snippet: AnyFlow validation is wired through the distiller scheduler hook for registered FlowMap-capable pipelines. Custom or external validation paths still need to pass r_timestep or timestep_r into the model component. The on-policy stage currently requires a standard PEFT LoRA so its discriminator can share the frozen base transformer.
